description:
The scheme SMTWOC stands for the Scheme for the Management of Tribal Welfare Organizations and Communities. 

It aims to enhance the socio-economic conditions of tribal communities in India. 

The primary objective is to provide support for the development of tribal welfare organizations. 

Benefits include financial assistance for capacity building and infrastructure development. 

Eligibility is typically limited to registered tribal welfare organizations and communities. 

The application process involves submitting a proposal to the relevant state or central government authority. 

The timeline for application processing may vary based on the specific project and funding availability. 

The Ministry of Tribal Affairs is the implementing authority for this scheme. 

Additional details regarding specific funding amounts and project types may vary by state.
